model.label: Model
model.autoHint: Short chats use the fast model; long or reasoning-heavy requests use the quality model (configured in Settings → Auto-tiering)

agent.label: Mode
agent.tip: Agent mode runs a real tool loop: the model can call connected MCP tools and workspace tools (read_file / list_directory). Configure MCP servers + workspace root in Settings.
agent.suffix: You are operating in agent mode. You can call tools when they help answer the user — use them to read files or list directories inside the workspace. Call a tool when needed, then use the results to answer.
agent.noTools: Agent mode is on, but no tools are available — add an MCP server or workspace root in Settings.
agent.maxIters: Agent loop stopped: reached the iteration limit.

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.tip: Per-model setting (saved when you change it). Sent to the server as reasoning_effort, but the server does not act on it yet — models also support different levels, so this is a UI-level preference for now.

composer.noModel: Load a model to start chatting.

empty.noModelBody: Chat needs a loaded model. Scan and load one first.

coding.name: Coding
coding.text: You are an expert developer. Write clean, efficient code with brief explanations.

writing.name: Writing
writing.text: You are a careful writer. Produce clear, well-structured prose and offer edits with reasons.

analyst.name: Analyst
analyst.text: You are a rigorous analyst. Reason step by step, state assumptions, and separate facts from inference.

concise.name: Concise
concise.text: Answer as concisely as possible. No filler, no preamble — the essential information only.
